etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: Borrowed from Italian virtuoso, from Late Latin virtuōsus (“virtuous”), from Latin virtus (“excellence”). Doublet of virtuous.
senses: (now historical) An expert in virtù or art objects and antiquities; a connoisseur. [from 17th c.]
Someone with special skill or knowledge; an expert. [from 17th c.]
Exhibiting the ability of a virtuoso.
